sentences.en: A field inherits the theme too
Arrange real Blocks into a page plan and copy the arrangement.
sentences.zh: 把真实的区块排成一个页面方案，并复制这份排布。

sentences.en: Blocks, rendered by the real components in the order you set.
sentences.zh: 区块由真实组件按你设定的顺序渲染。

sentences.en: Draw your own data through a real chart and take the code away. The preview and the snippet are built from the same state, so what you see is what you copy.
sentences.zh: 用真实图表把你的数据画出来，并把代码带走。预览与代码片段由同一份状态生成，看到什么就复制什么。

sentences.en: Draw your own data through a real chart, then copy the code that drew it.
sentences.zh: 用真实图表画出你自己的数据，然后复制画出它的代码。

sentences.en: Every value above is a token the library already ships; the Studio adds no new ones.
sentences.zh: 上面每一个值都是库里已有的令牌；工作室不新增任何令牌。

sentences.en: Four attributes, a live preview and the exact line to copy.
sentences.zh: 四个属性、一个实时预览，以及要复制的那一行。

sentences.en: Intensity scales the system's motion physics; the primitive reads the reduced-motion preference and changes state instantly when it is set.
sentences.zh: 强度会整体缩放系统的动效物理；原语会读取「减少动态效果」偏好，在该偏好开启时直接切换状态。

sentences.en: No Blocks left. Add one, or start again from the archetype.
sentences.zh: 已经没有区块了。添加一个，或从原型重新开始。

sentences.en: Only declared props are exposed here: a callback, a ref or a custom node is not a control.
sentences.zh: 这里只暴露已声明的 props：回调、ref 或自定义节点都不是可调节项。

sentences.en: Pick a palette, a type voice, a personality and a depth, watch the same components change, and copy the single line that produced it.
sentences.zh: 选一个色板、一种字体语气、一种性格和一层纵深，看着同一批组件随之变化，然后复制产生它的那一行。

sentences.en: Positions change; the process does not
Radius, density, leading and motion come from the personality.
sentences.zh: 圆角、密度、行高与动效都来自「性格」。

sentences.en: Read the data, not the volume
Start from an archetype, move and remove Blocks, and copy the arrangement. Every Block is one the gallery documents — this composes pages, it does not invent them.
sentences.zh: 从一个页面原型开始，移动或移除区块，然后复制这份排布。每个区块都是画廊里已有文档的区块——它组合页面，不发明页面。

sentences.en: The same components, one attribute set
The value axis is formatted from the unit you declared. A chart renders what it is given and never converts a unit.
sentences.zh: 数值轴按你声明的单位格式化。图表只渲染传给它的值，从不做单位换算。

sentences.en: This subtree carries the four attributes. Nothing below was styled for the preview — it is the public API.
sentences.zh: 这个子树带着那四个属性。下面的东西没有为预览做过任何特殊样式——它就是公开 API。

sentences.en: Tune the motion primitives against the intensity register they actually read.
sentences.zh: 拿动效原语对照它真正读取的强度档位来调。

sentences.en: Tune the real props of a motion primitive against the intensity register it reads, and see the difference rather than argue about it.
sentences.zh: 用动效原语真实的 props 对照它读取的强度档位来调，直接看到差别，而不是争论差别。
